components.name: Appointment Surface
components.description: A grounded schedule item with identity, time, and state.

narrative.overview: Amar Dentist combines the quiet confidence of a carefully kept clinic register with the immediacy of a live route. Every surface shows where the user is in the care journey, what has been verified, and what happens next.
keyCharacteristics: Calm pearl fields with navy structure and sparing mint/cyan signals.
Clear journey continuity from discovery through appointment to record.
Platform-native controls with brand expressed in content surfaces.
Compact professional density without nested cards.

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Mint and cyan communicate availability, position, verification, or progress; they are never decoration.

rules.name: Grounded Surface
rules.body: Ordinary content stays flat; elevation describes a real layer or interaction state.

dos: Do use status words and icons alongside color.
Do show real operational state, recovery, and authorship wherever trust is at stake.
donts: Don't use gradients, decorative glass, generic medical crosses, tooth mascots, or neon healthcare imagery.
Don't build pages from repeated same-size icon cards or nest cards inside cards.
